Exemplars are rated on a 7‑point scale ranging from not at all average/ideal/'good example' (0) to completely average/ideal/'good example' (7). The prototypicality score is derived by averaging three entities, which measure the degree to which the given prototype is a "good example", "paradigmatic example", or "prototypical example".
LLMs rate each exemplars on three dimensions: average, ideal, and the prototypicality of the exemplar.
